prompts.prompt-r1.txt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset: Spain gallery documentary master. Create a wide 16:9 natural low-light photograph of Es Vedrà from the public Cala d'Hort beach shoreline, Ibiza at 01:14 local time on 24 September 2026. Low eye-level looking southwest over a calm dark Mediterranean channel. Show the unmistakable steep asymmetric pyramidal limestone mass of Es Vedrà rising directly from the sea, with lower smaller Es Vedranell nearby; dark pebbly-sandy beach foreground and a little sparse coastal vegetation. Model conditions indicate fog, so add only realistic light marine haze softening the horizon and rock edges while keeping both islets recognizable. Deep dark overcast-to-navy sky. No moon, stars, Milky Way, boats, buildings, visible lamps, island lights, people, cave framing, cliff-edge viewpoint, fantasy glow, text, logos or watermark. Restrained long-exposure realism; center Es Vedrà for a strong 4:5 crop.
